plan.question: Does the independently selected long-prefill layout preserve/improve the original fast route with decode configuration fixed?
plan.execution: Official bench.sh --prefill-only --prefill-tokens98304 --think --runs4;one short warmup then four fresh117489-token requests per independent process. Original6e40/candidate590f/candidate590f/original6e40/original6e40/candidate590f. First long request remains separate from the three subsequent requests.
plan.constants: Original canonical decode configuration:131072 resident INT8 context,1256 slots,8192 prefill,5 workers,pcie0,adapt0,spec4,suffix0,caches0,Q8 MTP,no token graph/no coupled draft. Identical arithmetic/placement/safety flags. Candidate590f additionally sets PREFILL_SEPARATE_LAYOUT1 before exec;original6e40 keeps the setting absent. No mid-process environment mutation.
plan.actual_route: Verify effective environment on the owned native process before its first long request,all five actual native/journal extents,four8192-chunk GPU BF16/mode10 long passes and candidate prefix budget/math. With caches/checkpoints disabled,the pinned selector deterministically uses explicit layer-major for n>8192 and chunk-major for the warmup;no silent explicit-long fallback is permitted. There is no direct enum log;this is a source-bound route proof using owned environment and actual request/dispatch records,not a claimed observed enum.
plan.observers: Remove NEO allocation logs,UR memory subscriber,stage/state/cache readbacks,census and timers. Keep the qualified native-only UR validation/retained-loader preload and warning logs in BOTH arms. Parameter validation is charged to both;this is not an observer-free speed claim or ordinary-teardown qualification.
plan.decision: Use each process subsequent-three median,exact tokens/engine_ms. Preserve every sample. Candidate faster screen requires all three paired ratios>1 and geomean>=1.0005. Prefill no-decline screen requires every ratio>=1. Target screen requires every candidate process median>=1000. A failed screen remains failed;no threshold/order change or noise dismissal. None qualifies decode or adoption.
plan.timing: Every long request must last>=10000 engine milliseconds. Before EACH native process,run the pinned CPU C++ steady_clock probe once:65536 adjacent pairs. Require steady clock,1ns period,positive CLOCK_MONOTONIC resolution<=1us and the pinned same libstdc++ provider. Screen (2*observed_max_pair_ns/1e6+0.05ms)/10000ms<=0.0001. The0.05ms term is DONE decimal rounding. This is measured endpoint-cost/precision eligibility,not a universal latency bound or instrumentation-overhead correction;keep validation costs charged and all actual times unchanged. No retry on calibration failure.
plan.stopping: Stop first source/config/model/route/journal/owner/fault/budget failure. No retry,skipped/replaced process or speed-based early stopping. Commit each closed outcome before the next process. Full15 model hashes at preparation and after process5;identity/stat pins before/after each process.
plan.next: Independently compare repeated thinking-on long generation for both observed MTP classes and upstream long/agent-session suite with the original decode implementation/configuration/1256 slots. Any decode impact is a separation defect;do not adopt while it remains. Physical262144/task/session/failure-owner gates remain distinct.
plan.interpretation: Package comparison after capacity/state gates,not causal kernel attribution or measured hardware saturation. Existing whole-model limits remain;no new speed gain is claimed before the samples.
plan.retention: Keep individual request clocks/counts/hashes,phase decisions,source/config/actual route/owner/fault evidence. Successful raw logs/JIT retire after committed replay;retain only the two existing native generations for this imminent prefill/decode comparison.
